title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Metaphor…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Ditty News Ticker by Metaphor Creations, LLC, affecting versions up to 3.1.71. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
